notes.title: Patch 1.3.3 - Welcome 2025!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/fdbf241a479d09da7ce4e2d246a21a38b1584c50.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, adventurers![/h2]

We hope your journeys through the realms continue to bring you thrilling adventures and unforgettable memories. [b]Welcome to 2025[/b]—a year that could be a game-changer for Realms of Magic! But first things first...

[h2]YES, ANOTHER UPDATE![/h2]

[b]We’ve taken a moment to address some persistent bugs that have been bothering players[/b] for a while. While this is a smaller update, we hope it provides relief to those of you facing these frustrating issues. Here are the patch notes:

⚔️ Modified Stonebridge Merchant location to avoid a potential soft-lock;
⚔️ Fixed the issues with the Brawler skill;
⚔️ Fixed the issues with the Executioner skill;
⚔️ Fixed the issues with the Strike from Above skill;

⚔️ Prevent the player from using special symbols in save slot name and character name, which caused issues;
⚔️ Allow unsupported zoom levels in video options.

[h2]WHAT’S NEXT FOR REALMS OF MAGIC?[/h2]

We’d like to take this opportunity to reassure you that our plans for Realms of Magic remain unchanged. Currently, our primary focus is on the development of our second game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2499520/Be_My_Horde/]Be My Horde[/url], which is available in Early Access. [b]We’re gearing up for its full release in the latter half of 2025[/b]. Once this project is complete, we’ll shift our efforts to active development for both the [b]Realms of Magic remake and Realms of Magic 2[/b]. In fact, some conceptual work will start even sooner!

We know many of you are eagerly awaiting new adventures in the world of Realms of Magic, and we share your excitement! [b]However, as a small team, we can’t tackle two completely different projects simultaneously[/b]. That’s why we’re focusing on wrapping up Be My Horde first. On the bright side, this journey has been incredibly rewarding—our team has grown stronger, and we’ve gained valuable experience that we can’t wait to apply to the next chapters of the Realms of Magic saga.

[h2]Stay tuned for more updates later this year![/h2]

[b]Cheers,
The Polished Games Team[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.2 - The Return of the Cursed
notes.notes:
[h2]At long last, the Cursed are back![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/aae1d2b806e7f2ccb633d855d307da43806ad5b6.gif[/img]

The Cursed race is back, and now they feature their unique Game Mode!

The Cursed are not tolerated in the Old Kingdom and are attacked on sight by anyone and everywhere. If you choose to play as this race, you won't be able to complete quests, trade, or train.

Instead, you will be given the opportunity to plunder villages and, if you are brave and powerful enough, take on the entire city of Stonebridge by yourself!

Additionally, because the Cursed can't complete quests, all quest locations are unlocked for them as soon as you discover a map for that Realm.

You didn't like a particular NPC? Now you can do something about it!


[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Changed Necromancy mana cost reduction talents to bonus mana
[*]Fixed issue with mana reduction not working on weapons and Elixir of Wisdom
[*]Fixed issue with Drysoil Hero achievement not triggering for some players
[*]Fixed issue with summoned creatures sometimes breaking on Protected locations
[/list]
[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

Since last year's Full Release, we've been working on something big and exciting. The 1.0 release showed us that there is definitely a huge potential in this game idea. We are getting close to 50 000 copies sold, despite the lack of marketing and, let's be honest, loads and loads of jankiness in the game.

We will have a big announcement in the upcoming months as soon as we solidify our plans for the next several years to come. Can't wait to share it with you!


[h3]Unitl then,
Polished Games Team[/h3]

notes.title: News and Version 1.1.1
notes.notes:
It's been a while since the last update. After the full release and the crazy month that followed it, we took some extended time off to finally rest after working on Realms of Magic for 8 years (we started way back in 2014).

Currently are working on update 1.2, which will bring back the Cursed race, which will have significantly different gameplay than other races, as literally everyone will be hostile towards you. Villages will no longer provide a safe haven, instead they will become deadly places filled with strong enemies. Update 1.2 will arrive in early December.

We want to thank you all for the successful launch. During the first three months since the full release, we sold more copies than during the entire Early Access, which lasted almost 5 years! This month we are going to surpass 40 000 copies sold in total, which is absolutely huge for us!

This successful launch will allow us to fully realize all of our plans (and more!) for the Realms, we will have a big announcement in early 2023 about the future of Realms of Magic.

[previewyoutube=VODC3VF8hlE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Dear fans,

Today is the day! After many years of development, we are thrilled to bring you the full version of our first game - Realms of Magic. It is a labor of love filled with amazing people who are either part of Polished Games or used to be at some point.

We believe that the Old Kingdom can genuinely bring you hours upon hours of great fun reminiscent of classic fantasy RPGs with the addition of open-world mechanics. And we mean HOURS of fun - this inconspicuous game has a ton of content. We made sure of that!

It was a long and, at times, rocky (premiere delays anyone?) journey. However, as of right now, we couldn't be happier and prouder to be able to present to you these fruits of our labor.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Full Version Preview is here!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]This version marks the end of a significant period in Realms of Magic’s development. You will finally have the opportunity to see everything the Old Kingdom offers! We’ve implemented some final pieces of content and features and solved most of the balancing issues. However, it doesn’t mean the work is all finished! We hope that with your generous feedback, we can still add some additional fixes in time for the game’s official departure from the Early Access on July 20th![/b][/h3]

EDIT: This is the repost of the original post from June 15th, as the original one wasn't displaying properly for some users.

[h2][b]Intro & Outro[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=VnARxogz4Gk;full][/previewyoutube]
One of our main goals was to up the ante in terms of the game’s narrative. The Old Kingdom has many stories to tell, and we wanted to create a more epic, cinematic feeling for two of the most significant points of this grand storyline - the beginning and the ending.
You can check out the intro above. And if you want to see the outro… you’ll have to finish the game!


[h2][b]New title screen[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/40fdbe14dceebb664aefb1a37d9cd885352dad52.gif[/img]

This update is also a perfect opportunity to improve the game’s aesthetic from the very first screen after launching Realms of Magic. The new title screen is more slick and stylish than its previous iteration. Apart from the fresh background, you can also listen to the brand new track prepared by our fantastic composer - Davi Vasc.


[h2][b]New loading screens[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/d9a6363bae0551f785008177dfc442b5ed87a877.gif[/img]

The devil is in the details. That’s why we also wanted to introduce new loading screens to improve the game’s atmosphere even during the short loading times.


[h2][b]Rebalanced Professions[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ad9d4a3ba84b11ab881d7a975d29022ed8a7a8f1.png[/img]

We’ve implemented a brand-new experience curve for the game’s Professions. We believe it will create a better feeling of progression and make exploring various Professions more fun.


[h2][b]Level Up Bonus Experience[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/dc95d3acffeb0fcc8f3e33091e7dcf6722b8023f.png[/img]

At long last, we have restored Bonus Experience from Profession Level Ups, making sandbox activities and skilling Professions much more rewarding.


[h2][b]Rebalanced Recipes[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/da1fb5b541a2ac0234dc0303a4ee3add92c5de56.gif[/img]

We’ve decided to rebalance all of the crafting recipes in order to, once again, create a better feeling of progression and avoid any issues with overpowering or underpowering the player’s character. We’ve changed over 1300 crafting recipes!


[h2][b]New Crafting Tilesets[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/b3234fe36becac5b6ef577824dbee4040dea8a66.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/0e45c6a38e8279e3a24032cb49c22b14ffe2fec0.png[/img]

Take a look at these new tilesets that will vastly expand your crafting arsenal! Time for some serious redecoration!


[h2][b]Loot Rebalance[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/863b4e90e5cc1d2feabe4c3a8abc98359599897e.png[/img]

Going through every single in-game container wasn’t an easy task. However, it was necessary in order to ensure that the loot distribution is properly balanced… and we wanted to avoid another incident of finding some late-game loot in one of the game’s first areas!


[h2][b]Rebalanced Item Stats[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/107e1286e1a9320d03be10ccf1146edb1d18d73c.png[/img]

Like going through in-game containers - rebalancing over 3000 items is no easy task. And yet, we can proudly say that we were able to adjust the stats of available in-game items and create a smoother difficulty curve.


[h2][b]New Armor Sets[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/6e330d938077473fd66034474865ad3e03524bd5.gif[/img]

Oh, look! Is that #fashionrealms on the horizon?! Yes, yes, it is. Currently, the number of obtainable armors has reached the level of 120 sets. It might not be OVER 9000 (one day… one day), but we’re still thrilled with the results. 


[h2][b]Rebalanced Combat Talents[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/7756407f0b9fa8ac04c8f80828e74400e7cb096b.gif[/img]

We couldn’t forget about combat, could we? As with every significant aspect of the game at this point - you can expect a significant rebalance of crucial values. Moreover, we’ve also decided to improve talent tooltips to convey better what these abilities do.


[h2][b]Rebalanced Enemies[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ba5c2326b32d1628afd7ef8a4d118d540b89d9e8.gif[/img]

The combat rebalance includes not only your abilities or gear… but also the enemies you’ll be facing. They will be better accustomed to your character’s level at any point in the game. However, they will still be rather deadly, so do watch out.


[h2][b]New Difficulty Settings[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/91e659ac8285226b3ace35a834dfc9b1a9e9801e.png[/img]

As you might’ve noticed - this update is mainly about various rebalances. However, we also want you to be able to tailor your own Realms of Magic experience as much as possible. That’s why we’ve decided to include new difficulty settings. There are the usual “easy, medium, and hard” options along with a special “custom” setting for you to have fun with!

We recommend the Normal setting for new players, as it provides a fair amount of challenge. For Realms of Magic veterans looking for a challenge, we recommend the Hard difficulty, as it’s actually quite hard.

[h2][b]What's next?[/b][/h2]

Now is a perfect moment if you have been waiting to jump back into the Realms of Magic. While we will still be doing minor balancing and polishing over the next month, we won’t be working on any major overhauls for a while.

We hope to hear from you about the state of the game’s balance and which elements should be buffed or nerfed. We are also looking for ideas for minor changes that would positively impact the player’s experience.

The Official Launch of 1.0 will include one new secret feature related to the Trading profession, which will receive a significant update in that version.

[h3][b]As we’ve mentioned, this update marks a milestone in Realms of Magic’s history. We are delighted to present you with all this complete content, and we hope it will bring you nothing but fun and joy. And yet, we still hope to see you during the grand celebration on July 20th, when our game will leave Early Access!

See you soon,
Polished Games Team[/b][/h3]

notes.notes:
[h3][b]The time has come! You’ll be able to discover everything that the Old Kingdom has to offer… at least when it comes to its realms. However, remember that Blackwall isn’t the most scenic of places. On the contrary, it’s quite dangerous and… dead. At least you’ll finally finish the game’s main plot, right?[/b][/h3]


[h2][b]New realm[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/9afd246492cf40c560c6cc7218162d6b30709bca.gif[/img]

Many things can be said about Blackwall. None of them are particularly favorable. Just look at it! It’s grey, barren, and deadly. It is filled to the brim with Deathless! But that’s how it has to be, right? The hero’s journey should conclude in the roughest of places. Well… this is it, the worst that the Old Kingdom has to offer. What are you going to do about it?


[h2][b]Two sub-biomes[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/c5e8833bcc150021b63e5c78c23a8316c50aac42.gif[/img]

Blackwall has all the shades of grey! So many that we had to split this particular realm into two sub-biomes. These two different stages are distinctive as we wanted to mark a specific shift in this realm’s nature. To let you know when things will go from bad to worse.


[h2][b]New quests[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/c5134d88f70dca60012ab74b438b153a31ce374b.png[/img]

So why should you even venture into this belly of the beast? To conclude the game’s main storyline, of course! Moreover, you might find some interesting and captivating stories or people among this realm’s many ruins.


[h2][b]Boss fight[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/3052af1e0e725e826209099944ab18dc9ec0b52a.png[/img]

Yes, you read that right. Realms of Magic has a final boss fight! Isn’t that exciting? We don’t want to spoil too much here as we want you to discover it for yourself. Let’s just say that this encounter is a pretty wild ride.


[h2][b]New creatures[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/406796755012f34651c05eecaf649d7eceff323a.gif[/img]

Blackwall is home to many, many awful creatures, not only Deathless. We are talking about Rotten Ghouls, Undead Wolves, Undead Boars, Death Imps, and Abominations. That’s an awfully mean team that’s ready to mangle you. Are you prepared to take this challenge head-on? 


[h2][b]New armors[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/664e790c2961d30f1b0d5aba2df0ecd74c726259.gif[/img]

Hey, look! #Fashionrealms is back! That’s right - we bring you a plethora of new armors! These are probably some of the wildest, most fantastic gear designs in the whole game. Get yourself some of that endgame stuff!


[h2][b]New tiers[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/3feae6dd76b18dd3a21570ec0226c32f366cb1c6.png[/img]

Welcome to the DYI section of the “cool new gear” alley. Cursedsteel, Titanium, and Ebon are the three new top tiers of crafting materials. This includes some powerful new armors but also weapons and even tools.


[h2][b]New blocks[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/6c33aefad35ee7e4327b8dcd795b79cea776d7ef.png[/img]

Speaking of DIY - Blackwall will also introduce several new building blocks. So you will also be able to add this grey and Deathless flavor to your dream house.


[h2][b]New music[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=wOJQltbyguU;full][/previewyoutube]
A place as disturbing as Blackwall deserves to have some genuinely haunting music. We proudly report that our amazing composer, Davi Vasc, delivered that in spades. These tracks have a way of really getting under your skin.


[h2][b]Pop-up dialogues[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/eaa8d5e1f5d26acd42b5e8c2663dcf1f97db1d51.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 0.25 - Blocks Update
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Today's update is for all DIY enthusiasts! "Blocks" might sound like some weird, metaphorical entity. However, they truly are a vital part of the Realms of Magic! After all, they are the building blocks of a huge chunk of the game's world and environments. And right now... you will have access to even more of these building blocks to make your wildest worldbuilding fantasies come to life![/b][/h3]


[h2][b]New blocks[/b][/h2]

You might have seen some of these blocks in various handmade locations, but they were previously unattainable for players. Now you will receive many, many new blocks to play with! To truly emphasize the actual scale of today's update, we've decided to show you a small comparison. Below you can see the blocks that are currently available in the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/134c16c477946d10e96a0c3df668a8259499d751.png[/img]

That's a lot of blocks. Well, here you can check out all of the blocks that are available thanks to today's update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/53d4be5610ed42b5bc1241985d42d8020ff891bd.png[/img]

That's a pretty impressive set of building tools! Moreover, here's a little sneak peek of blocks that will become available in the game's full release (you'll be able to find them in the Blackwall province)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/81e885a6bc9e5a01bd12b5cee2b08a4caf67974e.png[/img]

[h2][b]Rebalanced Mining and Woodcutting[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/aec79de0cf465dae23c86b1c78ef84e02adaa712.gif[/img]

The addition of the new blocks is a perfect moment to introduce another set of rebalances! This time it's all about the two of the most vital professions in the game - Mining and Woodcutting. We have recalculated and rebalanced values of block durability and tool damage. Okay, so what does it mean? Some blocks might take a couple more hits to their "face" before falling apart. Don't get us wrong; we still want you to have the incentive to craft new tools and make you feel like progressing through the game. However, we don't want to make things ridiculously easy and make some late-game blocks disintegrate after a single hit.

[h2][b]Modified ore generation[/b][/h2]

We've also changed how various ores are generated in-game. The ores are now a bit rarer; however, they generate on the floor of the caves and thus are way easier to find and excavate.

[h2][b]More fantasy-themed block names[/b][/h2]

Updates like these are also a perfect moment to take a step back and look at the more minor details. Realms of Magic is as much about the roleplaying aspects as it is about the sandbox worldbuilding simulation - that much is true. And yet we wouldn't exactly call it "geologist simulator," would we? We felt that some of the previous names felt a bit off. They were too serious and had a weirdly scientific overtone. That's why we've decided to go back to the roots and focus a bit more on the fantastical themes of the Old Kingdom. Here are some examples of the new names:

[h3][b]Tarachyte --> Soulstone
Gabbro --> Quicksand
Phonolite --> Runestone[/b][/h3]

They do sound better, don't they?

[h2][b]Updated music tracks[/b][/h2]

Wait a minute! Can you hear that? Yup, our music tracks now sound better than ever! Thanks to the fantastic performance by Lucia La Rezza, some tracks now include an epic live violin! Moreover, many different tracks have also received some smaller adjustments. Check out the astounding difference between a digital sample and a live instrument performance here:

[previewyoutube=L49SZOgT004;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=V8VtIt-hOUk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Things to come[/b][/h2]

This update? That's just the beginning. This week will be BUSY! We will have a string of exciting posts and announcements! So stay tuned because you don't want to miss it!

notes.title: Roadmap to Version 1.0
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Can you see it glowing on the horizon? That’s right! The game’s full release (aka Version 1.0) is real, and it’s out there! However, we still have some fair bits of rebalancing and polishing to do. All in the name of giving you the best gameplay experience possible.[/b][/h3]

[h2][b]Blackwall Province[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/8455c41da9e63f7f7f287016c850b16bb73c8896.gif[/img]

The last of the Old Kingdom’s provinces is almost done! In fact, its quests and locations are fully complete. However, we still have some significant issues (such as sandbox content, enemy encounters, and loot placement) to tie up. But don’t worry - the province itself looks… actually quite dead and barren… but that’s kind of the point here, okay?


[h2][b]Boss encounter[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/3052af1e0e725e826209099944ab18dc9ec0b52a.png[/img]

We really wanted to give the more story-focused players a proper send-off. This final encounter with the “big bad guy” aims to do just that. We believe that it will be a fitting culmination of a rather long and rocky journey. We are currently checking and rebalancing this feature to make sure that it’s good enough. The fight will also have its own music theme (it’s also a work in progress). 


[h2][b]Balance and polish[/b][/h2]

To be honest, this part right here is where we still have the most work to do. Because (once again) we aim to bring you some brand new features, improve the old ones, and make sure that the game plays well. This particular category has some truly important subcategories so let’s go over them:


[h3][b]Combat rebalance[/b][/h3]

Yup, the good ol’ combat system is back to haunt us! Well… not really, but we are preparing some pretty significant changes. We want to completely overhaul all combat values (such as damage, health, etc.) to find the perfect difficulty curve across all in-game provinces. We also want to improve our tooltips for talent and spell descriptions to make everything clear and coherent.


[h3][b]Improved encounters[/b][/h3]

We want to make the Old Kingdom feel more varied and dynamic. That’s why we want to include more diverse enemy encounters across sandbox locations and even some handmade locations. We will also introduce a couple of new humanoid enemies.


[h3][b]Professions rebalance[/b][/h3]

This might be the biggest change of them all. Some new recipes (along with a couple of new items), change of every significant parameter (exp, item durability, recipes), entirely new experience curve for all professions - it has it all! It’s a revamp of an already hefty in-game mechanic.


[h3][b]Gold rebalance[/b][/h3]

Let’s face it - the current in-game economy of the Old Kingdom could be compared to the financial crisis of 2008. It’s rough. Our goal is to make it a fair bit better (to at least push it past the crisis stage). We want to do that by introducing more reasonable prices and values of items.


[h3][b]Loot rebalance[/b][/h3]

We also plan to introduce a simple but effective loot overhaul. We want to give you fewer junk items and focus on the importance of unique and valuable weapons or armors.


[h3][b]Improved sound effects[/b][/h3]

We want the game’s sound to be as varied and pristine as possible. That’s why we plan to introduce some unique sound effects for different enemy types (let’s just say that tritons will finally stop grunting like troglodytes). Moreover, we are working on a slight combat sound overhaul.


[h3][b]Other minor improvements[/b][/h3]

There are, of course, going to be a whole lot of smaller improvements along the way — lots of bug fixes, minor quality-of-life changes, etc. Don’t worry; we will list them all some other time.


[h2][b]Release day suprises[/b][/h2]

Let’s just say that even despite giving you this roadmap… we still have a few aces up our sleeves! Some might say these aces are only cosmetic changes that don’t affect the game itself that much. However, we believe that the devil is in the details. Hopefully, these improved “details” will be a pleasant surprise for the returning players and introduce our more recent fans to a brand new level of quality. We will give you more information about this topic soon!


So here it is! We believe that this roadmap will help you understand our current situation. There are still some more significant improvements to make; however, the home stretch is genuinely approaching! We hope that this update will also leave you hungry for more!


Thank you for your continued support! See you soon!

notes.title: Version 0.21 - Improved Quests and Quality-of-Life Additions
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Another exciting update is here! This time around, we chose to revisit the game’s main storyline and ensure that it is consistent throughout the entire experience. We patched up some plot holes and created bridging quests that will let you know what you have to do next to push the main story forward. Moreover, we also added some requested quality-of-life improvements![/b][/h3]


[h2][b]Improved Quests[/b][/h2]

The goal here was to ensure that the game’s main storyline is consistent and ever-present in the players’ in-game journals. Now you will ALWAYS know what you have to do next to push the main branch of the story forward. Of course, uncovering the Old Kingdom’s mystery is entirely optional, and there’s absolutely nothing wrong with simply being a farmer and not caring about some sinister plot (let the city guards take care of it, am I right?).

[h2][b]Improved Journal Entries[/b][/h2]

We also went back and rewrote almost every journal entry in the game. We wanted to make sure that everything was written as clearly as possible while maintaining the highest degree of immersion.

[h2][b]Improved Journal Font[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/fd89ba09b99c337ca948043a7e4e2909236cc943.png[/img]

Okay, it’s tough not to quote that business card scene from “American Psycho” right here (if you don’t know what we’re talking about -  look it up, it’s worth it!) We might not be using Silian Grail here (and we definitely don’t have a watermark). However, we feel that the current version of the in-game text font is easier to read and generally more pleasant to look at. The Old Kingdom isn’t exactly known for its oculists, so it’s better not to tire out your eyesight with some hard-to-read texts, right?

[h2][b]Additional NPCs with Training Option[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/22b779595c77c113a33696b47660b10da4ab7a9c.png[/img]

Knowledge is power! That’s why we made access to said knowledge way easier. Now, even more NPCs have the option of on-the-spot training in various professions.

[h2][b]Improved Professions Window[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ad9d4a3ba84b11ab881d7a975d29022ed8a7a8f1.png[/img]

We also made some minor upgrades by adding profession icons and improving profession tooltips.

[h2][b]New Weapon Sprites[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/83d7d48eba74b8425a3346831c2cdbeff04b9329.png[/img]

Weapons also received a slight graphical upgrade. We’re talking specifically about weapons dropped by various in-game creatures that now have some brand new sprites. With the name such as “Abomination Decapitator” (pictured in the bottom right corner), you have to represent, right?!

[h2][b]New Doors, Hatches and Chests Animations[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/38d0b33edc7b11d5932c8cb74655393d7898467b.gif[/img]

notes.title: Version 0.20 - Rebalance update
notes.notes:
[h3][b]We know that our game’s balance (or slight lack of it) has been a problem for many of you. It’s probably been the most requested thing when it comes to stuff that we should improve in the Old Kingdom (apart from the ludicrously high taxation… we can’t do anything about that, though)! So here it is - the first part of an entire wave of various rebalances, tweaks, and improvements (along with some other cool stuff)![/b][/h3]

[h2][b]First major rebalance[/b][/h2]

The first rebalancing wave will focus on a few of the most vital components of the game. We’re talking about: character progression, level of difficulty, loot distribution, and changes in attack/movement patterns of NPCs and creatures. Moreover, you can expect more tweaks and rebalances in the future!

[h2][b]Improved character progression[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/d4fa333bef659f70ab4c8d80df6830f7062d0b78.jpg[/img]

Don’t you hate it when your character becomes way overpowered for whatever the game has in store for you in the following area, and it gets rather dull? Yeaaaaah… guilty as charged, we suppose? Anyway, the improved exp distribution system is meant to solve this problem and vastly increase the level of fun and challenge the game will give you!

We want your character to progress naturally through the game’s world and/or story and give you a feeling that every gained level is an achievement in and of itself and not just a boring formality that doesn’t amount to anything.

[h2][b]Improved level of difficulty[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/acf7aa583599d25ea05cd5647d7ff789d8d72709.png[/img]

The exp rebalance (along with some other things we will talk about in a minute) is also meant to increase the game’s difficulty! The challenge is here! Time for some punishment! Let us feast on your tears of hopelessness! #realmssouls #realmsborne

Okay, that might’ve been a bit too much (after all, Realms of Magic is not a soulslike). However, we want to throw a more significant challenge your way to make the game way more fun. Moreover, we also aim to eliminate any potential distractions (such as too easy encounters or too quick progression) that could effectively ruin your experience in the Old Kingdom.

[h2][b]Change in patterns of NPCs and creatures[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/82ef91811498edf6d38cc78369b88fe15f905aaa.jpg[/img]

Did somebody say something about “liking to move it, move it”?! Yup, that’s a 2005 meme coming straight at you. However, this phrase could, in a way, summarize our approach to changing the movement patterns of NPCs and creatures.

This change will also affect the game’s difficulty. We aim to make the enemies more aggressive, more elusive, and generally turn them into a way bigger challenge. We feel that improving their attack and movement patterns is the first step towards turning them into dangerous forces to be reckoned with.

[h2][b]Improved loot system[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/9263fd72701bf0af1673e1f730e85ffd9b953610.png[/img]

Realms of Magic allows you to gather A LOT OF various types of loot (weapons, armors, crafting materials, food, etc.). We are proud of the sheer amount of stuff we can offer you. And yet, we also can’t ignore the flip side of things.

Sometimes the enormous amount of loot was too chaotic for you to handle. That’s not a good thing. Not everyone has to be a fan of excessive inventory management. That’s why our improved loot distribution system will aim at giving you just the right amount of stuff at the right time! No more carrying two storage units worth of property (along with some of that grandma’s inheritance) on your back! #letthebackrest

[h2][b]Improved dialogues and texts[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/a9ba8562cb401ff7f78ffd53d3e242895ded982c.jpg[/img]

No lenguage, miztakez hire! This update isn’t only about improving the mechanical aspects of the game. We also went through every in-game text and dialogue (every… single… one...) and eliminated every possible misspelling, misplaced comma, or unnecessary word. We corrected over a thousand various errors! All in hopes of vastly increasing your immersion in the game’s world and its story.

[h2][b]Improved Game Data Storage[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/71bb7b513d813a970aab7d83aeaa59330c2d371c.png[/img]

Time for some technical info! #hackingtime

Over the last couple of months, we’ve been improving the way we store data. Manual adjustment of hundreds and thousands of different parameters in the game was too time-consuming. That's why we’ve decided to start moving the game data to Google Spreadsheets, which we can then import as CSV files.

Currently, we have successfully moved the following data to spreadsheets: experience curves and values, hostile NPCs, and most of the loot in the game. By using these neat formulas, we can do things waaaaay faster. For example - previously, if we wanted to make changes to combat parameters of enemies, we had to go over every NPC in each location and adjust their values manually, which could take an entire working day since we have hundreds of NPCs. Yup, it's as tedious as it sounds. Now we can input parameters in the spreadsheet (which takes just several minutes), and all NPCs in the game will be adjusted automatically.

This allows us to iterate the game much faster and enables all players to mod the game and tweak these values to their liking as these parameters are no longer hardcoded into the game’s executable but are loaded from easily modifiable files. While it’s unlikely we will be able to add full Steam Workshop mod support anytime soon, we are planning on releasing these tools (along with simple instructions on how to use them), which should enable you, the players, to modify a significant amount of content on your own!

[h2][b]New music tracks[/b][/h2]

Here’s something for all the enthusiasts of splendid sounds! Our fantastic composer, Davi Vasc, has prepared even more great in-game tracks. This time he has focused chiefly on new dungeons and caves tracks. So now you will be able to listen to some great music even under the ground itself! We believe that these additions will highly improve your exploration experience. Check it out!

[previewyoutube=iTCX1pAiVQ8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Sounds neat, right? That's just a small sample! You can check ALL NEW MUSIC TRACKS (there's a whopping 10 new songs) HERE:[/b] https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-2eiyKzwajTgxcG6ax_ZUkcazqur4s3b

[h2][b]Other changes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved quest names - they now sound like actual quest names instead of generic objectives.
[*] Alternative, peaceful resolution is now available during the Splinterville storyline.
[*] And one more heavily requested change - all water containers like bottles are filled all at once instead of one at a time.
[/list]

[h2][b]What's next?[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] We are getting close (like really, REALLY close) to the 1.0 version release. We will announce the final 1.0 version release date soon!
[*] The last realm (called Blackwall) is in the final stages of development and will be released along with the 1.0 version update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/406796755012f34651c05eecaf649d7eceff323a.gif[/img]

[*] We are currently working on the boss fight that will wrap up the storyline!
[*] We are focused on balance and polish, so there won't be any new features and content before version 1.0 is released; instead, we will be working and improving on already existing content. 
[/list]

Our main goals for the near future include:
[list]
[*] Progression and difficulty iterations - this patch is only the first iteration. We will be iterating it further based on your feedback.
[*] Loot distribution - this patch included changes to the loot system. However, this is only the tip of the iceberg of what we want to achieve in version 1.0.
[*] Professions rebalance - we will be going over each profession and make sure that they will be more balanced and fun to explore.
[*] Improved quests - we want to include more dialogue options and choices.
[*] Improved sound effects - we're mostly thinking about improving combat sound effects.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/6fe1496a4d3a5c58ffd34837f52a16623b071999.jpg[/img]

[h3]Oh... and one more thing! WHAT'S GOING ON WITH ALL THESE DRAWINGS ABOVE?!?! Well... as you might know - the Old Kingdom has a rather rich history and many stories to tell. In fact, we felt that some of these tales need a bit more context and that we want to explore them even beyond the boundaries of the game itself. [b]That's why... we're making an official Realms of Magic comic book! Stay tuned for more details!!![/b][/h3]

Our goal with racials is to make experience of playing each race as unique as possible. If you feel that your favorite race isn't up to snuff, then let us know, so we can buff it - or nerf it in case of Gnomes.

notes.title: Beta Update - New Tutorial and Balance
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Can somebody stop us?! “Old Kingdom’s Pandemic Updates”™ are still going strong! This time we are extremely proud to present you a feature that many of you asked for and it took us quite some time to properly prepare. Brand. New. Tutorial. Moreover, we are also slowly starting to sink our teeth into another big feature - the balance of the game.[/b][/h3]

[h2][b]New Tutorial[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/669d123a4cdfaabc6193b40168b08a7ee03cade1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ea25d9b532901ced300607c1a2cc6ff302040eab.gif[/img]

We want this game’s new introduction to be as clear and gripping as possible! It’s not only about introducing all of the intricate mechanics but also allowing you to become immersed in the Old Kingdom’s tumultuous world from the get go. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/a3fa71f24b5f48b012ed5c9035f336ba385cef07.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ad1560b3c0758e58261d554f471b5344f47af913.gif[/img]

This version of the tutorial will allow you to get accustomed with all of the basic mechanics (movement, digging, building, character and equipment management or fighting) while also serving as an actual prologue to your adventure with unique characters and storylines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ad2f862318d1d3d4733ef354537acb2627098f93.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/c141474cf622a9d3b6e7fe57930322e80a23942d.gif[/img]

However, and we’re talking about veteran players now, you will also have an option to simply skip the tutorial level and get straight into the Old Kingdom’s vast landscape! Yet, we would like to ask all of our generous beta testers to not only test the tutorial level themselves but maybe even show it to some of your friends who haven’t heard of our game? Yep, we want your siblings’, your mother’s and even grandfather’s feedback on this one!

[h2][b]Initial Balance[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ea3c57f96c745db423424a037b2af941e750155d.gif[/img]

Our goal is to make “Realms of Magic” as fun and as challenging as possible and right now we are in the process of rebalancing the entire game. Right now the very first province has received its initial rebalance and we need your feedback!

[h2][b]Way more to come...[/b][/h2]
That new tutorial really took us some time to prepare… but does it mean that we can make the updates less frequent now? HECK NO! In fact, the next update will definitely be H U G E! Next time you will hear from us… Realms of Magic will be moved to Stable Beta version! It means that the current version of the game (now available only to beta testers) will replace the Alpha 0.7.1 version on Steam and become the default version of the game available to all! 

It’s a pretty big deal and probably the last stretch of the road before the final, full release of the game! The Stable Beta version will have all of the main features planned for 1.0 release (apart from the very last province and many smaller fixes or balance issues). Moreover, the Stable Beta version will have even more new, never before seen features such as:

[h2][b]Achievements[/b][/h2]
Yep, time for that sweet, sweet progress validation with Steam achievements! These trophies have always been a highly requested feature and we are proud to announce that we are close to finalizing their implementation!

[h2][b]Scrolls[/b][/h2]
An entirely new mechanic that will allow you to get special scrolls (through quest rewards or killing monsters) that will give you some great (and maybe even permanent) bonuses to your stats!

[h2][b]New music[/b][/h2]
You hear that? That’s the sound of victory… or simply our awesome new music tracks composed by Davi Vasc! The game will receive over 30 minutes of new tracks and you can check some of them here:

"The Harvest" track will be used as a theme for Wheatfull province.

[previewyoutube=eSpMbQRozf8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Beta Update - Fire, Frost and Alchemy
notes.notes:
[h3][b]“Old Kingdom’s Pandemic Updates”™ are absolutely on fire (and this update will show you that we mean it quite literally)! It’s time to finally wrap up our major combat overhaul with two final types of magic - Fire and Frost. We made sure that freezing your enemies and burning them to a crisp is more effective than ever! Moreover, we also added some crucial changes to the Alchemy profession so that you can finally fulfill your dreams of being a specialist in the field of suspicious looking potions. Check out what else we have in store![/b][/h3]

[h2][b]Fire Magic Overhaul[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ccef15fddf0741c45c86510d38789122ed1a9c6e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/fe5f75a6d9276f4207bcb5d6ff4f651b2cfe5adb.gif[/img]

We are not saying that the scorched earth policy is the only way to go in the Old Kingdom, however, we also can’t deny its effectiveness. That’s why we are going to give you even more ways to burn your enemies down. Such as Incinerating Aura, a powerful field that engulfs you and damages your foes on impact. They will regret trying to be all “up close and personal” with you.

[h2][b]Frost Magic Overhaul[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/d60f7d0f810bbd33f5bd9f82f6d20f3cbab80b92.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/7b5c8f0b927927adeaa571d1e3e6e7a24b31e753.gif[/img]

And now for something different. Why burn to the ground when you can freeze it for eternity, right? If that’s your method - Frost Magic is the way to go! This school of magic also has received new spells. Ice Shards are a perfect example of just how lethal this magic tree can be! Just send at least 3 powerful icicles (at once!) towards your enemies and simply watch them suffer. Yep, it’s that easy!

[h2][b]Alchemy Overhaul[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/031d23b61b601d490aec361ea8cf9b375b08ecd6.png[/img]

Time for some brewing! Are you getting tired of finding weird new materials and having no recipes to tell you how to use them? Fear not! We have added many new alchemic recipes for potions and elixirs! They will allow you to use tons of materials found throughout the world (such as plants) and even items looted from enemies. Become the absolute master of suspicious, NOT medically cleared concoctions!

[h2][b]More to come...[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/971e6cddb13080756bd974de87e89d57843a1d14.gif[/img]

Whew! That was something, wasn’t it? Believe us - we are not going to slow down with these frequent updates. In fact, the next one is just around the corner, and with it we will introduce a brand new tutorial! We know that the Old Kingdom’s veterans might be shaking their heads right now, however, let’s think about newcomers and their experience (or lack thereof). We want this fresh introductory sequence to be as attractive and informative as possible. We aim to create a tutorial that not only teaches the gameplay mechanics but also acts as an introduction to Realms of Magic’s lore and worldbuilding. This feature is still a "work in progress" and might slightly change in the upcoming weeks!

Moreover, we will also add new recipes for tailoring and some new music tracks to the game so stay tuned (get it?)! And then there’s yet another thing...

[h2][b]Achievements Announcement[/b][/h2]
Attention all completionists! Your pleas have been answered, we are officially working on adding Steam achievements to Realms of Magic! We are very thankful for your feedback on this matter and are extremely proud of being able to fulfill one of your biggest and most frequent requests. See you all at a 100% completion rate! 

Thanks a lot and see you during another “Old Kingdom’s Pandemic Update”! 

[h2][b]Want to help us with testing this update?[/b][/h2]

It's very simple! Just check out our Discord for details, look in the #beta-info section!

[url=https://discord.gg/5AfQ3BH][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/49fa34d2d101b6709fc71cf04c88d6f589446de9.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Beta Update - Nature, Necromancy and Cave NPCs
notes.notes:
[h3][b]“Old Kingdom’s Pandemic Updates”™ are going strong! In fact, you can expect a wave of smaller, more frequent updates in the upcoming weeks. This is the first one. It's time for us to start introducing some major changes in magic trees. We will start with Nature Magic and Necromancy. Moreover, we will also show you some new enemies that will populate various cave systems throughout the game! Oh, and at the very end, we would like to tease some more upcoming changes so stay tuned![/b][/h3]

[h2][b]Nature Magic Overhaul[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/d6615f3cce49c3d722116b039a56a6d32ae7db9d.gif[/img]

Time to summon the power from nature's very core! Harness the life-giving forces and unleash powerful attacks upon your enemies! Show them that their laughter (about you being "some kind of wacko tree-hugger") will be extremely short-lived. Especially when they meet face to face with your boar and wolf summons!

[h2][b]Necromancy Overhaul[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/db391bfaee474b4f3e41cc29d172cba1dfdc6126.gif[/img]

Anyway, you will have a cool and powerful battalion at your service... so... problem solved?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/60c39a81f896aa3772fe81f98d355f8a1d04baf9.gif[/img]

Merfolk, insectoids, and skeletons (along with many other abominations) roam the dark underground tunnels... searching for their prey. However, remember that more monsters = more loot!

[h2][b]Stable Release Announcement[/b][/h2]

Time flies so fast! December 6th, 2020, will mark the 3rd anniversary of Realms of Magic's Early Access launch! The game has changed a lot over the past three years. The rest of you will have the chance to check it out on [b]December 7th, 2020![/b]

However, this version of the game will have all of the planned features and content (except Blackwall mentioned earlier). We want to show it to the widest audience possible and get some additional feedback from you, the players, and use that information for the final push of balancing and polishing!

[b]Unfortunately, your saves from 0.7.1 will not be compatible with the upcoming stable version![/b] The scope of changes and modifications is simply too large for us to be able to import your saves. However, 0.7.1 will still be available on a separate branch and you will be able to continue playing your current character on that version. Moreover, saves created in the upcoming stable version will be compatible with all future versions of the game!

[h2][b]What's next?[/b][/h2]

We mentioned that right now we are focusing on slightly smaller, but more frequent updates. The next Beta Update will be introduced several weeks from now and will include further magic overhaul (Fire Magic and Frost Magic) along with major changes to Tailoring and Alchemy professions.

notes.title: Beta for version 1.0 is coming! Time for a major overhaul!
notes.notes:
The sheer amount of brand new additions and changes in this version is simply staggering! It could genuinely be compared to at least several major updates combined.

2019 was a calm before the storm. We’ve released two major updates: 0.6 - The Magic Update and 0.7 - The Caves Update. But the development of Realms of Magic hasn’t slowed down one bit, the pace actually increased as we were simultaneously working on both major updates and the massive 1.0 version.

This update aims to overhaul and improve the majority of the game's systems and content. All these features are interconnected - changing one thing requires modifying multiple others. Each major change required balancing other elements and that’s why we decided to release 1.0 as one massive update.

Without further ado, let’s see what kind of future awaits the Realms of Magic!

[h1]World Overhaul[/h1]

[h2]The Map[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/79bb30cb6a75213f4e614aad590b2f653634cda7.png[/img]

The old world will die... drowned in the high seas of past updates... and a brand new one shall take its place! Most of the previous locations and quests have been moved and changed along with the multitude of new quests being added. The map itself has also changed.


[h2]Provinces[/h2]
Travel beyond the horizon and discover 7 provinces that constitute the Old Kingdom. However, you will have to fight for your right to visit them, as they will gradually unlock with your progress. Why should you even care? Every province means unique enemies, creatures, caves and resources.


[h2]Remastered locations[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/81d5f32ef0a3a313d9c1357040f8521f9b43989c.gif[/img]

This update is not only about introducing the new but also enhancing the old. All locations in the game were drastically improved or even completely remade. All in order for them to look and play better. By the way, no more empty plains! Now when visiting a dungeon you get to it right away, without the need to run an actual marathon through forests to get there! #norunningforme


[h2]Remastered quests[/h2]
We have not only changed how the Old Kingdom looks... but also what tasks you might encounter along your way. All quests are now more intricate, better written and provide you with improved dialogue options.


[h2]Stonebridge - Capital of the Old Kingdom[/h2]
The Old Kingdom is a living, breathing world. However, it's quite hard to show its scale by making you visit smaller villages and settlements (we don't have anything against farmers, though!). But now it’s time to visit Stonebridge - the Capital City of the Old Kingdom. In fact, this place is so big that we had to split it into two different districts, as we couldn’t fit it in just one location (yep, it's that part where we brag a little)!


[h2]Main storyline[/h2]
During your escapades through the seven provinces you will uncover various threats and dangers that loom over the innocent inhabitants of the Old Kingdom. Once uncovered... will you be strong and wise enough to stop them?


[h2]Guild questlines[/h2]
During your journeys you will encounter four different guilds. Each guild has its own agenda with unique rewards for your help. Stonebridge is a serious city for serious people - you will have to side with at least one of the three guilds and prove your worth.

Join the Temple, a religious cult worshipping the Old Gods, the dominant religion in the Old Kingdom. 

Fill the ranks of the City Watch, a military organization keeping peace in Stonebridge city and its surroundings.

Align yourself with the Winking Eye, the criminal organization that tries to disguise itself as a trading company.

After you have proven yourself in one of these groups you will be able to join the Sellswords, a highly powerful guild employing renowned mercenaries from all corners of the Old Kingdom. Who knows... they might even play a major role in determining the fate of this realm. ;)


[h1]Combat Overhaul[/h1]

[h2]New weapon types[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/939a827cc7182ea6075c216ae85c5e982cb6b045.png[/img]

Don't get us wrong, Swords, Axes and Maces (previously available weapon types) are great. They are pretty solid pieces of equipment that are necessary for your survival in the Old Kingdom. However, we also understand that different people have different tastes. Maybe you want to stab someone instead of slashing them? Maybe you want to keep your distance? And just maybe... you want your sword to be human-sized? No judgment here, and that's why Update 1.0 will introduce 5 new weapon types: Daggers, Spears and Heavy Swords, Heavy Axes and Heavy Maces.


[h2]Attack patterns[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/5bd3d01218f433b7e0dfc1474a32c46fc141bae6.gif[/img]

Previously weapon types differed from each other only on the visual level. This new update will introduce attack patterns for every type of arms. Weapons will now have their own, unique attack patterns that will allow you to strategize more and be better prepared for dangers to come.


[h2]New abilities[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/38c49282c18bc3510209d3044bec661678968d20.gif[/img]

Psst! Hey! Hey, man! You want some melee with that magic? That's right, each magic tree will receive one new ability that is a hybrid between melee/magic skills. These abilities will be using Stamina instead of Mana and will easily improve your mage build with some hybrid capabilities! #nerfthat


[h2]Overhauled skill trees[/h2]
Every skill tree has been majorly overhauled. Our goal was to make each and every talent impactful and fun to explore (who knows, maybe one quest will even require you to win a new edition of the hit show "Old Kingdom Got Talent"?! <- nah, that's a lie... or is it?). Anyway, we removed some of the talents or merged them into one and several new ones were added.


[h2]New NPC AI[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/69fb04a9cf56fb0a1fa8b5320cc50a9c0ebeda10.gif[/img]

Watch out! NPC's are coming and they are ANGRY! All because we have improved their attack patterns. Each enemy type will behave differently and rely on various arsenal of attacks and skills. For example, orc brute will focus on slow but powerful attacks (they might be easier to dodge... but may the Old Gods help you, if some of those strikes reach you), while a roguish bandit will rather apply some sneaky-cheeky hit and run tactics.


[h2]Other minor changes[/h2]
We’ve also made a multitude of smaller changes that will improve how combat in Realms of Magic feels. These tweaks include: reworking blocking and shield mechanics, reworking stamina costs for ability usage and changing the flow of movement in combat.


[h1]Sandbox Overhaul[/h1]

[h2]Provinces and biomes[/h2]
Current version of the game incorporates only two types of biomes, plains and forests. Update 1.0 will, once again, shake things up a bit. Each of the 7 provinces will have its own landscape filled with unique animals, monsters and resources. Plains and forests will now contain the same types of resources, however, forests will have more of them... but also will be much more dangerous to roam through - a treat for the fans of a classic high risk and high reward design.


[h2]Caves[/h2]
Each province will also have its own cave system with another set of unique enemies, resources and treasures. In the current version of the game every location has the same types of caves with 3 different cave tiers. Update 1.0 will eliminate different cavern tiers within the same location, however, each of the 7 cave biomes will significantly differ from each other, both in terms of their visuals and content.


[h2]New creatures[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ba5c2326b32d1628afd7ef8a4d118d540b89d9e8.gif[/img]

Remember when we wrote that NPCs are getting ANGRY with their new attack patterns? Well... don't forget about the monsters because their ranks are getting bigger by the minute! Update 1.0 will introduce over 15 new creatures. Everyone of them will have unique sprites, attack patterns, special abilities, combat parameters and loot.


[h2]Expanded professions[/h2]
Creating new biomes, caves and creatures also means introducing new resources needed for crafting. That's why Blacksmithing, Leatherworking and Tailoring professions will receive the most significant increase in available recipes... just in time for the Old Kingdom's fashion show season!


[h1]Gear Overhaul[/h1]

[h2]New tiers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/94b886391c4b03b2e8868d34d0dcdfb7b5d814aa.png[/img]

New resources also mean new tiers of armor, weapons and tools. Blacksmithing will receive Adamant, Titanium, Demoncursed and Ebon tiers. Leatherworkers will be able to craft new items from Dark, Thick and Shadow Leather, while Tailors will get Cotton, Khandar and Zariot fabrics.


[h2]New armor sets[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/3c10c509bbdc1bcb67042089e0758b00b6166b9f.png[/img]

We also have some great news for all you fashion freaks out there! The total amount of armor sets will increase... significantly. Update 1.0 will provide you with around 130 different obtainable armor sets. Some of them will be crafted, some looted from enemies, others will need to be purchased from merchants, obtained as rewards for completing quests or simply found in randomly generated caves and secret locations. But more importantly - YOU WILL ALWAYS LOOK FLY! #fashionrealms


[h2]Unique weapons[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ead4821a73ca180b4418a522a014b483ea40f1b7.png[/img]

For the fans of cutting, slashing and/or crushing - don't worry, we do remember about your destructive needs. Currently all weapons are crafted through Blacksmithing profession, however, Update 1.0 will introduce some brand new unique weapons that will be obtainable in other ways.


[h2]Special equipment parameters[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/107e1286e1a9320d03be10ccf1146edb1d18d73c.png[/img]

Alright, alright, we will admit it - currently the only difference in armor sets is the armor value. But we assure you that the gear will get waaaaaaaay more interesting. Armor sets will receive special parameters that will make every part of your gear unique and special in its own right. Here are some examples of said parameters: increased mana, increased melee damage, increased fire spell damage, increased health of summoned undead etc.


[h1]Improved Map Interface[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/bfc3d1cc2f6a82ea948e51915779bcc0bcffadc0.png[/img]

Along with the new map we’ve updated the map interface by vastly improving its behavior and adding several heavily requested features [because we DO appreciate your suggestions :)] such as the ability to add notes and markers on the map.


[h1]Secrets and Powerful Enemies[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/178ce2ba47cbc76368427f9b96e7f1f9690bb10d.png[/img]

Secrets are cool, right? Uncovering them is even better (even if you have to slain some big monsters along the way)! That's why each location will now include a number of secrets to discover and powerful enemies to slain. Secrets may contain Mysterious Essence, while powerful enemies will drop Powerful Essence. Combination of these powerful items will create the Potion of Knowledge, which will permanently grant you one talent point.


[h1]Profession Trainers[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ca8f8078d7208b59a3f32a1e80dfbb098588934f.png[/img]

Let us tell you - the current job market of the Old Kingdom can be really capital "R" Rough! That's why some NPCs will now offer you training in various professions in exchange for gold. The higher your profession level, the higher the training cost. It will serve as a convenient way to speed up profession leveling while providing a valid gold sink for your precious finances. Come on, invest in your future!


[h1]Final Boss[/h1]
An amazing storyline deserves a suitably big conclusion! That's why Realms of Magic shall culminate in an epic encounter with a truly powerful boss that will provide a major challenge to even the most powerful of characters.


[h1]New Tutorial[/h1]
Once again, time for some honesty. The old Tutorial Dungeon was decent but rather stale and uneventful. We will be replacing it with a completely new tutorial. The goal of this new introduction is explaining basic controls as well as showing the best parts of the game from the get-go.


[h1]Balance[/h1]
We’ve taken major steps to significantly improve the balance of the entire game. We’ve created a special tool that will be able to send us (with your permission!) anonymous data that will help us with balancing various elements of the game: combat difficulty, economy, character and profession experience curves, sandbox progression etc.


[h1]Minor Features[/h1]

[h2]Location reset system[/h2]
If you haven’t visited one of the sandbox locations for a while then you will have an option to reset it. Why even bother? This process will make all resources in the game truly infinite.


[h2]Improved dialogue window[/h2]
The dialogue window has been increased and equipped with a bigger font. We’ve also made some changes that will cause dialogues to be more fluid and responsive.


[h2]Improved merchants[/h2]
You will encounter more merchants during your journeys and you will find their stock to be much more varied and useful.


[h2]...and more![/h2]
There are just too many smaller tweaks and changes to simply list them all here but believe us that they will make Realms of Magic a much more POLISHED GAME.


[h1]Final Words[/h1]

[h2]Beta[/h2]
If you can’t wait to try the new version (can't blame you there :P) and want to help us with developing it, we have good news! In just a couple of weeks we will be releasing the first Beta version of Update 1.0! This version will include the first 3 out of 7 provinces and most new features in their WIP state.


[h2]Release date[/h2]
When Update 1.0 is going to be released? The initial plan was to release it this Spring, however, due to the increased scope of the game, we decided to push back the release date to Summer of this year. What can we say... perfection needs time! ;)


[h2]Discord[/h2]
If you want to participate in the Beta, you will be able to do so by joining our official Discord server:
https://discord.gg/9nS3sMb

We know that this post wasn't the shortest but huge thanks for sticking with us, we hope you are as excited about Update 1.0 as we are!

[h1]Your Polished Games Team[/h1]

notes.title: Cave Update 0.7 was just released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/98486926e6c6b4323d5b18418c0f7c5aa6cf4c0a.png[/img]

Every sandbox location now generates random caves for you to explore. Inside you will find new dangerous enemies and sweet loot guarded by them.

Currently random caves consist of [b]three tiers[/b], the deeper you go, the more powerful monsters you will encounter and the more valuable treasures you will find. To make caves prettier and easier to navigate we've added glowing crystals and mushrooms that light up surroundings.

To make getting out of caves easier we've made a big change - now you can [b]travel from anywhere[/b], you no longer need to reach edge of location or find a signpost to do so. We have also [b]improved Mining profession[/b], previously it only increased damage you do to blocks but now it will also increase the mining speed.

Please bear in mind that caves won't generate in locations you've visited before this update.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/27VfP2Y/0-7-Gif-Caves.gif[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/1af87a9cb3384596b15d6728f5438162620c4f2f.png[/img]

In caves you will encounter two new creatures: [b]Cave Kobolds[/b] and [b]Mole Rats[/b].

[img]https://i.ibb.co/cv0D1mN/0-7-Gif-Kobold.gif[/img]

[b]Cave Kobolds[/b] are stronger and nastier cousins of usual Kobolds. Similar to their weaker counterparts they use hit-and-run tactics but with one major difference: instead of trying to hit you from up-close they are throwing their daggers from distance, which makes them much harder to defeat.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/pytCPwj/gif-molekat-min.gif[/img]

Similar to Cave Kobolds, the [b]Mole Rats[/b] are more difficult variant of Giant Rats. Their special ability is that they will run away and regenerate when they are hurt. When you encounter one Mole Rat this ability may not appear that powerful but when need to fight several of them, then you could be easily overwhelmed.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/a5fa0f2fb8cbe7ba884cf08dbfa3eb959da07025.png[/img]

Three new Blacksmithing materials have been added: [b]Mithril, Cobalt and Thorium[/b]. Mithril and Cobalt ores can be found deep in caves, while Thorium is an alloy of Mithril and Cobalt, similar to how Tin and Copper together make Bronze.

With each material you will be able to craft new and more powerful tools, weapons and armors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/f3f866f7419bf33bd8e31216d7b6f86792543b31.png[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/f24f99775edcfb290a95f12b267489f42c372153.png[/img]

We've overhauled color palettes for each race and [b]streamlined character customization[/b]. Now color options for each category will only show if your character is actually using them, for example you won't see hair color if your character is bald.

Our goal was to make sure that [b]each character created when you hit Randomize button will look good[/b], which wasn't usually the case before. This overhaul will not only make creating new characters easier and more fun but will also make NPCs you encounter in your adventures look better, as majority of them have randomly generated appearance.

This feature will most likely make your character look slightly different, if you are not happy with new colors then please remember than you can visit the Witch in the top-right corner of the map to change your appearance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/e27f41751c6f02b0f947adc691e4d14d56def834.gif[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/139cf9e70f0a8dded1906ebff32337b9a69f64cb.png[/img]

Very simple, yet extremely useful minor feature. Now when you look at piece of equipment, right next to it you will see item you have currently equipped in the same slot, which makes deciding if new item is an upgrade much easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/878bc9487d68d5829d44cd90c31cd042fb7a338a.png[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/3a036d90d8a46e766d83f7dfde90a70f8d10eb4a.png[/img]

The long-awaited Patch 0.6 arrived today. New features and improvements are mostly focused on [b]gameplay experience and new opportunities of combat style[/b] preferences during your adventures. We truly believe that our work and ideas will meet your expectations and reward your patience. 

Please find detailed list of changes below. Let’s get started!

[h1] [FEATURES] [/h1]
[b] Three New Magic Schools [/b]

Each Magic School has its own skill tree requiring  about 40 talent points to max it out. Talent points can be spent on learning [b]new spells and passive magic abilities[/b]. Nothing stands in your way to try a different builds and make mixes among them. 
As always - play it your way! 
Please find out all the details about New Magic Schools below: 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/m4k6T1V/Ice-Magic.png[/img]
Frost Magic School focuses on offensive gameplay style. Freeze your opponents with 5 new spells:
[list]
[*][b]Ice Spike[/b] works like ice missile.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/CPPG4rT/Ice-Spike.gif[/img]

[*][b]Cold Wave[/b] - cone shape freezing breath.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/CB4ghyr/Ice-Wave-v1.gif[/img]

[*][b]Ice Nova[/b] shoots ice spikes from the both sides of a caster which toss hit creatures in the air.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/kHJbc5y/Ice-nova-v1.gif[/img]

[*][b]Ice Barrier[/b] blocks and reflects incoming damage.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/LJp654H/Ice-Barrier.gif[/img]

[*][b]Deep Freeze[/b] is a stacking debuff spell. Each next stack slows enemies actions. 
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/WvcRkpJ/Nature-Magic.png[/img]
In Nature Magic School you can learn 3 summon spells and 2 utility buffs:
[list]
[*][b]Summon Rat[/b] - summons a rat companion.
[*][b]Summon Wolf[/b] - summons a wolf companion which can additionally cause bleeding on enemies.
[*][b]Summon Boar[/b] - summons a boar companion which can additionally slow enemies.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/4VZnmpY/Summons-v1.gif[/img]

[*][b]Regenerate[/b] - AOE buff which increases health regeneration for all allies.
[*][b]Stone Skin[/b] - AOE buff which increases armor for all allies.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/njwC6yr/Buffs-v3.gif[/img]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/kByKbtf/Necromancy.png[/img]
Necromancy is forbidden dark magic of death. Use 4 deadly spells to devastate your enemies.  
[list]
[*][b]Dread Bolt[/b] - deadly ghost missile that pierces enemies bodies. Causes damage to the opponents and makes them more vulnerable for incoming hits.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Mn0y5By/Dread-Bolt-v1.gif[/img]

[*][b]Summon Skeleton[/b] - raises undead who will fight for you. You can summon skeleton warriors and mages.  
[img]https://i.ibb.co/6gmwd2q/Summon-Skeleton-v3.gif[/img]

[*][b]Summon Ghoul[/b] - summons fast and deadly Ghouls.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/pRtJVS9/Ghoul-Summon.gif[/img]

[*][b]Grim Wind[/b] - AOE debuff which inflicts damage over time. It heals caster for percentage of caused damage. 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/f6P8lsS60ZwBHTvBcY/giphy.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h1] [CHANGES] [/h1]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/zFzLFzj/C-A.png[/img]

We have completely remade humanoid animations. Changes include all movement elements and combat skills. Gameplay seems to be more natural, satisfying and responsive. We have also improved melee combat by implementing coloured weapon trails. Detailed list below:
[list]
[*]New Animation for: walking, jogging, running, jumping, rolling, falling, punching, weapon drawing, shield holding, shield blocking, spell casting, eating and drinking.   
[*]Added weapon trails while attacking and preparing to attack. Combat skills does different colors which depends on used strength and attack speed. 
[*]Visual damage system has been improved. It is more responsive and satisfying when hitting an enemies. We have added blood on hit which made combat more attractive and juicy. 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/S8aEQPheoCgHmPzk30/giphy.gif[/img]
[/list]
[b]Active Bar[/b]
[list]
[*]Added 4 slots Active Bar which can be used anytime during gameplay.
[*]You can put in every potion, food, book and much more. Almost every “useable” item in game.
[*]Action Bar slots are activated by pressing F1 - F4 on your keyboard.  
[img]https://i.ibb.co/zZfJD2G/Potion-Bar.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]Idle Animations[/b]
[list]
[*]To make your world feel more natural and alive, we have implemented a total of 12 idle and actions animations. Each will be triggered depending on the situation and NPCs preferences. For example: enemies will show their happiness after your death :)
[img]https://i.ibb.co/1dzJ8v0/Idle-v1.gif[/img]
[/list]
[b]Level Up Effect[/b]
[list]
[*]Upon Level Up your character will explode with powerful energy which will cause damage and knockback enemies. It will also fully restore your health, mana and stamina.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/fDr6Grv/lvl-up.gif[/img] 
[/list]

[h1] [BUG FIX] [/h1]
[list]
[*]We fixed many bugs and issues that were found mostly by our beta testers. 
Huge thanks for invaluable support! (click: http://discord.gg/QvwhMdk to join our closed beta) 
[/list]

[h1] [FULL CHANGELOG] [/h1]
You can read the full list of changes here:

[b]Features[/b]
[list][*]Three new magic schools: Frost, Nature and Necromancy
[*]Combat overhaul
[*]New character animations
[*]Idle NPC animations
[*]Potion bar[/list]
[b]Changes and bugfixes[/b]
[list][*] Penalties for Light and Heavy armor were removed (right now heavy armor is simply the best, a new system will handle the matter in a future version)
[*]Rain no longer falls through roofs
[*]Hostile creatures no longer run away
[*]NPCs now walk when running away
[*]Level up effect (visual, full heal, knockback + damage)
[*]You can now travel from greater distance from the edge of a location
[*]Skills and Spells are now sorted
[*]Creatures no longer turn around when attacking
[*]Fixed pop-up dialogue spam
[*]Fixed eyes of several NPCs
[*]Fixed enemy name bars when healed
[*]Fixed Dungeon Saw position
[*]Fixed visuals of several armor sets
[*]Fixed background fog color
[*]Fixed trap damage bug
[*]Fixed Katherine dialogue
[*]Fixed Jute typo in guidebook
[*]Fixed Misc color text in GUI[/list]
[b]Next Patch[/b] will be focused on New Content and Randomly Generated Locations. 
New content items, armors, weapons, enemies, crafting recipes and so on will be also implemented in Patch 0.7.

We can’t wait to hear your feedback! Please let us know your [b]thoughts about new changes in Realms of Magic![/b] 

[b]We are humbly thankful for your support and all the kind words. As always stay Awesome Guys![/b]

[h1]Your Polished Games Team[/h1]

[h1]Polished Games Team[/h1]

[b]Irreversible changes are coming to our Realms... [/b] No more peaceful and quiet sunny days for all the time! Prepare a warm and waterproof coat cause you'll probably get wet! 

[h1]“Weather conditions”[/h1]

Firstly, with Patch v0.4 comes Weather System. Diversity of weather conditions will breathe more life into the Old Kingdom, making it feel more alive and immersive. We also improved looks of grass, leaves and other details. More “living” elements of the world will come within next months. 
Here are some examples of weather conditions that will be added to the game in this patch.

[h1]Fog[/h1]

[img]https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/_dRrSSjkbIoeFfMY6sFvc2Vc-BK2mj-_vNSQTu_bdi_HzVy7xjPE9TSfrBU=w1200-h630[/img]

Our missing RPG element that you asked for and we promised to implement. All character races in Realms of Magic will acquire their own unique set of bonuses and abilities. You can learn more about it during new game creation process. Unfortunately the “size” of dwarves will stay the same.. for now. Existing characters will gain the bonuses automatically after patch release.

Ingame option that will allow you to recreate the look of already created characters. You will be able to change face and skin appearance. Your initially chosen character race, will be unchangeable during later gameplay.

[h1]“The Witch”[/h1]

New special NPC appears in Realms of Magic. Find magical hut of The Witch and help her with a very special task… She will offer you unique furniture and items that can’t be acquired anywhere else.

You’ll be able to send trouble reports directly to our team after unexpected game crash.

We are aiming at the last week of July. Features in 0.4 still need some polishing, and we hope Open Beta will help us do just that.

We have just released very minor hotfix version 0.3.3 which fixed very critical bug:
[BUG] Fixed bug which could delete items from backpack when sorting inventory

[h1]Nave a nice day!
Polished Games Team[/h1]

notes.notes:
Our wonderful world will expand pretty soon... The most important thing we would like to share with you firstly is the fact that exploring all new implemented content will take twice much time compared to the current version! New fire magic skill tree, items, quests and locations aren't everything we have prepared for you. Our team was mostly focused on improving gameplay experience to make it more friendly and intuitive for RoM players. We realize how important the mechanics of gameplay are. That is why we’re trying to listen carefully to all comments and suggestions from our community. Implementing the most useful ones is our priority and goal in everyday work. Let's get started!


[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/isUgtlUipOcoLFiOIZhJFXD1Ni4abqDGqQO0eBNt_7UntYbwejnAPkhaNPs=w1200-h630-rw[/img]

To make the life easier and better we added a few things. Here are the new features and improvements we didn't announce before or were only briefly mentioned:

[b]Crafting[/b][list]
[*]Search functionality will allow you to find a specific item faster.

[/list][img]https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/HKmPGkj0PeLEzhLDcQgUpahLOk4SutQEOnZ6vqXf7TE8qt6_Mat5wiaPRVE=w1200-h630-rw[/img][list]

[*]"Total items crafted" shows how many items will by crafted at once.
[*]"Entering items quantity" - You will be able to enter a precise number of items to craft.

[*]"Crafting uses nearest containers" - Items stored in nearby containers will be now used automatically to craft items. There will be no need to keep all of them in your backpack.

[/list][img]https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/97zCZCGb7lHTnUY7ocb0MUStkqwx5rCnEa3zV7zdrr7OlHusfGbJT9AOy2w=w1200-h630-rw[/img]

[b]Backpack[/b][list]
[*]Easier bag replacement with smarter swap system.
[*]Bag sorting - Yes! We all have been waiting for it![/list]
[img]https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/UkMlOkaOsizyT0a_sGq9zrJ6iaVjZ22h0dFUvwqVl9ewbEkPO5B3WWfvJfw=w1200-h630-rw[/img]

[b]Quick Stack button[/b][list]
[*]Yay! Another feature that all asked for! :) No more slow and painful container management.[/list]
[img]https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/pHy78DB9FHHueVRBgvhwQUt3HN8mFwxwGoVaWN0-yRseRjsyee1_CCQ38PY=w1200-h630-rw[/img]

[img]https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/Z3NsXLqMO4CQ0M4buEN8l6wkUpqHDuPBiWjUNK0fFwASsBhKUzhMOb7FX08=w1200-h630-rw[/img]
